nodes.description: Private mapping (address => uint256) holding token balances for every account.
Private nested mapping (owner => spender => uint256) holding ERC20 spending allowances.
Private uint256 total token supply, reduced when tokens are burned.
Private address of the contract owner, guarded by onlyOwner.
Private uint8 token decimal precision (18).
ERU constructor: sets name, symbol, decimals, total supply and mints all tokens to msg.sender.
ERC20 transfer; forwards _msgSender() as sender to internal _transfer.
ERC20 transferFrom; moves tokens and decrements allowance via _approve.
ERC20 approve; writes allowance for msg.sender via _approve.
Increases spender allowance using SafeMath add.
Decreases spender allowance using SafeMath sub.
Internal transfer core: subtracts from sender balance and adds to recipient balance, mutating _balances state.
Internal burn core: subtracts amount from account balance and from _totalSupply.
Owner-restricted external burn; burns msg.sender tokens and reduces total supply.
Internal approval core: writes _allowances[owner][spender] and emits Approval.
Context helper returning msg.sender as address payable.
onlyOwner function transferring ownership to newOwner and updating _owner.
onlyOwner function setting _owner to address(0), renouncing ownership.
Caller-controlled address; drives minting, transfers, approvals, burns and owner checks.
Balance mutation arithmetic in _transfer (SafeMath sub/add on _balances entries).
Supply reduction arithmetic in _burn (SafeMath sub on _totalSupply).
Privileged burn entry point combining onlyOwner access control with msg.sender-derived burn account.

edges.reason: Constructor reads msg.sender to mint the entire initial supply to the deployer.
_msgSender() returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
Constructor stores msg.sender into the privileged _owner state variable.
transfer resolves its sender from the caller-controlled msg.sender.
burn uses msg.sender as the account whose balance is destroyed while also passing onlyOwner.
msg.sender feeds the privileged burn operation, enabling owner self-burn behaviour.
Constructor writes the full supply into _balances[msg.sender].
Constructor initialises _totalSupply to 1e9 * 10**18.
Constructor sets _decimals to 18.
Local msgSender captures _msgSender() and is assigned to _owner.
transfer delegates all balance mutation to internal _transfer.
transferFrom delegates balance mutation to internal _transfer.
transferFrom decrements the allowance via internal _approve after moving tokens.
approve writes the allowance through internal _approve.
increaseAllowance recomputes and writes allowance through internal _approve.
decreaseAllowance recomputes and writes allowance through internal _approve.
_approve mutates the _allowances state mapping.
_transfer mutates _balances[sender] and _balances[recipient] via SafeMath sub/add.
Current balances feed the subtraction/addition arithmetic of _transfer.
_transfer executes the balance arithmetic operation.
Owner-only burn calls internal _burn after the onlyOwner gate.
_burn subtracts the burned amount from _balances[account].
_burn reduces _totalSupply by the burned amount.
_totalSupply is the operand of the supply reduction arithmetic in _burn.
_burn performs the total supply subtraction.
burn is the privileged entry point that triggers the burn unsafe operation.
transferOwnership rewrites the privileged _owner variable under onlyOwner.
transferOwnership accepts a caller-supplied newOwner address.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0), removing privileged access.
transfer() recipient argument is passed into _transfer.
transfer() amount argument is passed into _transfer.
transfer() amount is an operand of the balance arithmetic in _transfer.
transferFrom() sender argument is passed into _transfer.
transferFrom() recipient argument is passed into _transfer.
transferFrom() amount argument is passed into _transfer.
transferFrom() amount is an operand of the balance arithmetic in _transfer.
approve() spender argument is written into _allowances.
approve() amount argument is written into _allowances.
increaseAllowance() spender is passed into _approve.
increaseAllowance() addedValue feeds the SafeMath add result stored by _approve.
decreaseAllowance() spender is passed into _approve.
decreaseAllowance() subtractedValue feeds the SafeMath sub result stored by _approve.
burn() amount argument is passed into internal _burn.
burn() amount is an operand of the total supply subtraction.
Internal _transfer sender parameter indexes the _balances mapping.
Internal _transfer recipient parameter indexes the _balances mapping.
Internal _transfer amount parameter drives balance mutations.
Internal _transfer amount is an operand of the balance arithmetic.
Internal _approve owner parameter indexes _allowances.
Internal _approve spender parameter indexes _allowances.
Internal _approve amount parameter is stored into _allowances.
transferOwnership consumes the newOwner parameter before writing _owner.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient_transfer is a transient parameter flowing directly into _transfer; merge into the core function that consumes it.
amount_transfer only participates in the balance arithmetic of _transfer; merge into the arithmetic unsafe operation.
sender_transfer is a transient parameter forwarded to _transfer; merge into the core function.
recipient_transferFrom is a transient parameter forwarded to _transfer; merge into the core function.
amount_transferFrom drives the SafeMath sub/add on balances; merge into the arithmetic unsafe operation.
spender_approve is written straight into allowance storage by _approve; merge into the core function.
amount_approve is written straight into allowance storage by _approve; merge into the core function.
spender_increaseAllowance is only used to write _allowances through _approve; merge into the core function.
addedValue is consumed by the SafeMath add whose result _approve persists; merge into the core function.
spender_decreaseAllowance is only used to write _allowances through _approve; merge into the core function.
subtractedValue is consumed by the SafeMath sub whose result _approve persists; merge into the core function.
amount_burn directly drives the _totalSupply subtraction in _burn; merge into the arithmetic unsafe operation.
sender_internalTransfer is a local indexing parameter of _transfer; merge into the core function.
recipient_internalTransfer is a local indexing parameter of _transfer; merge into the core function.
amount_internalTransfer is an operand of the SafeMath balance arithmetic; merge into the arithmetic unsafe operation.
owner_internalApprove is a local indexing parameter of _approve; merge into the core function.
spender_internalApprove is a local indexing parameter of _approve; merge into the core function.
amount_internalApprove is the value written into _allowances by _approve; merge into the core function.
newOwner is assigned to the privileged _owner variable inside transferOwnership; merge into the core function.
msgSender_local is a transient temporary in the Ownable constructor used to seed _owner; merge into that constructor.
